h15_ms_per_frame: VOCR3-H15: 664 CTC frames in 10 jobs' recognize= times (the owner: 5.0-5.2 ms); vita-vn-ocr's A9 model gives 5.00 ms at its 333 MHz upper bound
fs_append_ms: one open/append/close of a file on ux0 with the game running. The self-test's own timestamps measure it: each stage's closing report lines (a report, a status.txt and a log.txt append each) took 12.1-46.0 ms per append, median 15.7 (5 stages). The 11 jobs agree: what their Shell time leaves after the game's job, the lookup and the polls at their mean is 9.4-47.0 ms per append they made, median 20.9 (status.txt was still under 64 KiB, so a line was two appends, for 9 of them and part of a 10th). Range 9.4-47.0, estimate 15.7 (the direct one)
job_remainder_per_append_ms: the 11 jobs' remainder per append (median, min, max): not independent of the console check, which uses the same jobs
lookup_fixed_ms: a lookup's open, header and CPU: the intercept of ms against reads, 30 lookups
lookup_read_ms: one dictionary read (4 KiB at a random offset of the 134 MiB file): the slope
first_load_ms: load= of the 4 jobs that read the weights (the self-test's first stage and 3 of the 11): 1,155,968 B read and SHA-256 checked
